title: Easy to handle, brush top very flimsy
text:
Easy to handle, brush top very flimsy. I like the silicone feel of this mini silicone basting brush but the brush is very flimsy. I would like the brush to be a little sturdier. I have used it as a basting brush for barbecue sauce when using the grill. It is easy to clean and I like the colors.
Christine

product_metadata.title: GorGin Mini Silicone Basting & Pastry Brush, Oil & Sauce Spreader for BBQ Kitchen Cooking (3 Pack, 8.4 Inches)
